name: Drakuru story: Ruins of Drak’Zin
interpretationNote: Original interpretive environment illustration of Ruins of Drak’Zin, Grizzly Hills. Preserve these Wrath-era traits: Overgrown Drakkari stone terraces and carved tusked faces beside cold water, enclosed by red cedar and dark conifers; Grizzly Hills forest palette rather than Zul’Drak’s open frozen plateau. This is not a surveyed map, exact dungeon floor plan, or evidence of precise actor placement. Compare with the matching 3.3.5a client before human visual approval.
